# 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)

Generated by `npm run build` from the feature files in `src/components/` and the step definitions in `src/tests/_shared-steps/`. Edit those, not this file.

Level AA. [Understanding 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) on w3.org](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html).

Scenarios: automatic.

## Setup

- [`Given I load the sample "<input-url>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/1-Given/samples-load.js) — Loads a sample to test from a web URL.
- [`When I view the rendered "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-viewed.js) — Checks an element is visibly rendered on the page.
- [`When I click on "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/mouse-events-occur.js) — Clicks an element with the primary mouse button
- [`When I enable "<requested-mode>" mode`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Changes the colour mode in the browser. For example: light, dark, forced colours.

## Assertions

- [`Then its text should have a contrast ratio of "<min-ratio>" against its background`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/contrast-checks.js) — Automatically checks the colour of text against its background colour.

## Example

```gherkin
Background:
  Given I load the sample "http://localhost:8081/accordion/examples/default"

@1.4.3 @aa @automatic
Rule: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum), Level AA
  Scenario: A collapsed trigger has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the background
    When I view the rendered ".tl-accordion__section:nth-of-type(2) > button"
    Then its text should have a contrast ratio of "4.5" against its background
```
